segment.source: Renders one or two large sentences that introduce whatever follows, set above the body at a bigger size and looser leading. Use it for: the standfirst of an article, the summary line under a page title, the opening of a chapter, a short abstract above a long text. Prefer 'Rich Text' for the body itself, and 'Key Takeaways' when the summary is really a list of points rather than a sentence.
